binary_recommendation.summary: The proposed V8 primitive is sufficiently defensible only for one scoped 13-target Hosea book-local operation under an explicit, expiring, human-reviewed Windows and OneDrive environment exception. It is not a generally race-free or portable replacement primitive, and this ruling authorizes no publication.

win32_set_file_information_by_handle.operation: SetFileInformationByHandle with FileRenameInfo and non-null RootDirectory

nt_set_information_file_without_target_d.operation: NtSetInformationFile FileRenameInformationEx class 65 with flags 0x3, held destination root, and old destination target opened without FILE_SHARE_DELETE

nt_set_information_file_with_delete_shar.operation: NT root-relative replace using a verified source handle opened with FILE_SHARE_DELETE
nt_set_information_file_with_delete_shar.observation: Allowing FILE_SHARE_DELETE permits the handle-relative rename but no longer denies destination-entry substitution.

global_sentinel_handle_guard.scope: Deny write, delete, rename, and replacement of the exact held global sentinel files for the lifetime of the guard.

required_v8_design: Hold and verify a non-reparse destination-root identity, and retain the handle throughout each replacement.
Accept only an exact allowlisted leaf name with no separator, parent traversal, alternate-data-stream syntax, or path normalization ambiguity.

Create and verify the source temporary as a regular non-reparse file object; hash and size must be read from the held handle, write sharing must be denied, and the handle must remain open through rename and readback.
Use NtSetInformationFile FileRenameInformationEx class 65 with root-relative naming and the exact reviewed flags.
Immediately before rename, reopen the destination leaf relative to the held root and verify the expected preimage identity, size, hash, regular-file status, and non-reparse status.
After rename, verify bytes through the original source handle and separately reopen the destination leaf relative to the held root; require matching file identity, size, hash, and non-reparse status.
Apply the same primitive and safety classification to rollback replacements.
Hold the shared Hosea permitted-writer lock through transaction completion and mechanically exclude every patched legacy writer.
Hold verified global sentinel handles through the final completed-state transition.
Fail closed unless the pre-patch resident-writer gate and non-cooperating-writer quiescence gate both pass.

Classify every recovery target as exact_preimage, exact_stage, or unknown; rollback may replace only exact_stage with the exact archived preimage, while unknown must remain recovery_required for human handling.
Bind the exact runtime adapter, tests, operating-system and filesystem evidence, parent identities, target allowlist, and exception receipt by immutable hashes before use.

residual_races.window: After the destination preimage recheck and before NtSetInformationFile commits the rename.
residual_races.possible_effect: A non-cooperating writer can delete, rename, or replace the old destination entry. V8 can then overwrite a concurrent newer entry, producing an irreversible lost update whose bytes were not in the archive.
residual_races.reason: The held root and exact leaf bind where the rename lands, and the held source object binds what lands there; FILE_SHARE_DELETE leaves the old destination entry replaceable.

residual_races.window: After the rename and before handle/path readback.
residual_races.possible_effect: A non-cooperating writer can replace the published destination entry. File-identity plus hash readback detects the change if it occurs before readback completes.

residual_races.window: After the final destination readback and before or after the completed journal transition.
residual_races.possible_effect: A non-cooperating writer can change the destination after the last check, so completed state can become stale. Rechecking narrows but cannot eliminate this race.
residual_races.required_treatment: Environment-bound quiescence assumption plus postpublication verification; any detected unknown state remains recovery_required.

residual_races.window: A Python process that loaded the legacy writer before the shared-lock patch can write without honoring the new lock.
residual_races.possible_effect: Concurrent canonical overwrite or partial materialization.
residual_races.required_treatment: Fresh-host or exhaustive fail-closed process-inventory attestation. Access-denied, incomplete inventory, an unallowlisted older Python process, or an uncertain resident module blocks use.

residual_races.window: OneDrive or another process writes a canonical destination without honoring the Hosea lock.
residual_races.possible_effect: The same destination-entry lost-update or stale-completion races.
residual_races.required_treatment: Quiesce the sync or writer for the bounded operation, or explicitly include the risk in the human environment exception.

human_question.question: Should the owner require deterministic exclusion of every destination-entry substitution race, or accept the residual lost-update window for this one bounded Hosea publication under a fresh-host and quiescent-filesystem exception?

options.decision: Do not implement or use V8 for publication until a primitive or offline execution environment deterministically excludes non-cooperating destination-entry replacement from preimage check through completed state.
options.benefit: Fully upholds the strict reading of boss requirement V4-09.
options.cost: May require a different filesystem, offline copy-and-swap workflow, or stronger operating-system coordination not currently demonstrated.

options.decision: Permit only the exact 13 Hosea book-local targets after a fresh-host or exhaustive resident-process gate, OneDrive and other writer quiescence, shared Hosea locking, held global sentinels, exact handle-bound pre/post checks, and fresh independent exact-hash tests.
options.benefit: The held root and source handles prevent destination diversion and staged-byte substitution while limiting the accepted risk to non-cooperating concurrent destination overwrites.
options.cost: A residual lost-update and stale-completion race remains; there is no power-loss or 13-file set atomicity.

human_question.recommendation_limit: The recommendation is architecture advice, not owner authorization. The exception must be explicit, scoped, expiring, hash-bound, and independently checked.

preserved_dissent.reason: Because FILE_SHARE_DELETE is necessary for replacement, the old destination entry cannot remain exclusively guarded. An immediate recheck plus post-readback does not eliminate the check-to-replace or final-check-to-completed races, and a concurrent newer destination can be overwritten before detection. A strict reading therefore keeps V4-09 open.

required_exception_bindings: exact V8 adapter and test hashes
exact Windows build and filesystem volume
exact held parent identities and 13-target allowlist
fresh-host or exhaustive process inventory evidence

next_action: If the owner selects the scoped exception, implement V8 under a new immutable generation, freeze exact hashes, test every residual-race boundary and rollback path on the exact Windows and OneDrive runtime, obtain fresh transaction and premortem checks plus a separate boss ruling, and return to the owner gate. Do not publish from this architecture ruling.
